description: Resilience: non-existent entry yields an empty set without raising. A missing file inside an existing root directory (amd/zzz.js) and a missing file in a missing root both complete normally with empty output. An empty-string entry is non-null, so the adapter resolves it to the fixture base directory itself: traversal treats the directory as a single (dependency-less) node, which renders as the empty base-relative path followed by a newline.
